story.fullStory:
John Lennon's "Woman" reached #2 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Woman" is a song written and performed by English singer John Lennon from his 1980 album Double Fantasy.

The track was chosen by Lennon to be the second single released from the Double Fantasy album, and it was the first Lennon single issued after his murder on 8 December 1980.

The B-side of the single is Yoko Ono's song "Beautiful Boys".

The song peaked at #2 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 20 weeks on the chart.

The track was chosen by Lennon to be the second single released from the Double Fantasy album, and it was the first Lennon single issued after his murder on 8 December 1980.

The song peaked at #2 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 20 weeks on the chart.
Power to the People: The Hits is a compilation album gathering John Lennon's most popular songs, as part of the Gimme Some Truth box set.
It is available as a standard 15-track disc and download package, and as an expanded "Experience Edition" with a 15-track DVD.

Background
This album is a compilation produced to commemorate the 70th anniversary of John Lennon's birth and it became his fifth greatest hits album following Shaved Fish, The John Lennon Collection, Lennon Legend: The Very Best of John Lennon, and Working Class Hero: The Definitive Lennon.
